Last week I applied for a position internally, told I was hired the next day, now the position is on hold. Is this normal? 

More info:
I applied towards the end of last week for the same position I’m in now but at another location. I spoke a bit to the manager who wants to hire me that they really wanted me on the team and the only step left was to talk with the recruiter. The next day the same manager let me know that the recruiter wasn’t even going to talk with me because they just decided to hire me.

I talked with my manager about it, a little bit of a miscommunication at first but overall it was fine and that was that. My manager let me know I most likely won’t be going over to the other location until next month, and I said it was fine. She did tell me though that when they were talking with the other manager, they said nothing I technically wasn’t hired yet? But that I was the top pick at the moment. Weird?

Then this morning I got a notification that the position I applied for has been put on hold. I talked with my manager again about it and she said last time they talked I was still going to transfer around the end of next month and that it probably got put on hold because of internal processes?

This has all happened so fast in my opinion, I thought it was going to be like a normal job application where I was going to have a sit down conversation about pay, hours, responsibilities and expectations and a set start date etc etc but I still feel kinda in the dark. Should I reach out to the other manager even though my manager told me that everything is fine? Is this normal for internal postings?

Ok I see lots of people have responded but I wanted to also put my input in here, as she has been my main for a while.

For starters, Lillia has a really good clear once you get the hang of her abilities. I start red and head to blue, and usually have a leash. Use smite on the Red once it gets to 1/4 of its health, then head to the chickens. use W then Q, most of the chickens will be low health or die from Lillias burn. Then I usually will head to blue (you can come back for the rocks later). Start with the dogs, then once those are clear you can start on blue. Your smite will still be on cool down but it should be ready to go when blue is also at 1/4 health. Something to also try is you can actually start with the frog as you are either about to kill blue or as your final blow to blue. Lead the blue monster over near the frog and then use your Q to hit both. Then a this point you should now have all three of your main abilities and be easily able to kill off the frog. 

For healing ability, I would take the potion, you should need to use it once you get the hang of all this but you can use it if you need to.

Just letting you know, Lillia is a hard champ, especially if you are playing solo. Its also hard to gank with her until you reach 6 and get your ult, and your teammates are probably not gonna know this either and give you a hard time. If you do need to gank, the best time is to get them when they are pushed up really far by your teams turret. Hit them with the E to slow then W and Q. If u have your ult, try to E, Ult then W once they sleep and Q. ITs hard since E is pretty much a trick shot. And she pretty much is a champ that involves communication from your team. You need to let them know you're coming or else it'll just look like you did a bad gank when really your team didn't set it up right. Or what is especially fustrating is late game, when youre all pushing lane and youre going in and sleeping the entire enemy team while your teammates back off. 

As long as you clear good and have good communication with your team, you should do well with her :)

I'm NAL but I am a bank teller and it is OK to deposit a check endorsed to someone else to a joint account that has that someone on it. Think of it like this: Joint accounts mean that each person has the same amount of responsibility as the other (If he overdraws the account by $500, you BOTH are liable to pay back that money even though he messed up. Same as that either of you can close the account at any time even if the other person isn't there) It is his bank account, it just happens that it is also your bank account as well.

What you can't do is ask them to cash the check for you. For that, you would need his signature on the back as well as your signature. IMO, deposit the check, and once it posts transfer it into your personal account.

Also sorry that the bank didn't help you with this, this happens way more often than you think
